test.create_query: CREATE TABLE json_string_value_formatting (clean String, escaped String, separator String, escape_heavy String, doc String) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO json_string_value_formatting SELECT leftPad(toString(number), 70, 'x'), concat(leftPad(toString(number), 58, 'x'), '"a"', unhex('5c'), 'c/d', unhex('0a'), 'e'), concat(leftPad(toString(number), 64, 'x'), unhex('e280a8'), 'ab'), concat(repeat(concat('"', unhex('5c'), '/', unhex('0a')), 17), leftPad(toString(number), 2, 'x')), concat('{{"u":"https://host.example/', toString(number), '/a/b/c","s":"plain value"}}') FROM numbers(1700000)
test.query: SELECT count() FROM json_string_value_formatting WHERE NOT ignore(formatRow('JSONEachRow', clean)) SETTINGS max_threads = 1
SELECT count() FROM json_string_value_formatting WHERE NOT ignore(formatRow('JSONEachRow', escaped)) SETTINGS max_threads = 1
SELECT count() FROM json_string_value_formatting WHERE NOT ignore(formatRow('JSONEachRow', separator)) SETTINGS max_threads = 1
SELECT count() FROM json_string_value_formatting WHERE NOT ignore(formatRow('JSONEachRow', escape_heavy)) SETTINGS max_threads = 1
SELECT count() FROM json_string_value_formatting WHERE NOT ignore(JSONExtractRaw(doc)) SETTINGS max_threads = 1
SELECT count() FROM json_string_value_formatting WHERE NOT ignore(formatRow('TSV', clean, escaped, separator, escape_heavy, doc)) SETTINGS max_threads = 1
